description: Where did that come from? For refs returned by other Dactic tools (1-20), describes each item's source and a confidence of high, medium or low from a fixed rubric, with the rule that applied in `basis`. Rubric — terminology: high when confirmed with score >= 0.9 and no conflict, medium when confirmed otherwise, low when not confirmed. Knowledge: high when confirmed in an interview, medium when inferred from 3+ evidence items (or confirmed without a recorded confirmation), low otherwise or when disputed. Evidence: high when it supports confirmed knowledge, medium when it supports unconfirmed knowledge, low otherwise. Policy: high when in the current published COE version, medium when ingested from a document but not published, low with no source document. Skill: high when active and a live agent uses it, medium when active, low when retired. Playbook: high approved, medium pending review or needing follow-up (Dactic has no review step yet), low for a draft. Never repeats evidence text.
